result.topic_en: Riemann's 1847 notes on generalized (fractional) differentiation: a generalized Taylor series for z(x+h) in terms of fractional derivatives, consequences for negative/integer orders, the composition rule for derivatives of orders mu and nu, and linearity and shift/scale properties, with old notation struck out and replaced by the symbol ∂ in red.

methods.what: Generalized Taylor expansion of z(x+h) in terms of fractional derivatives of order ν−n, ν, ν+n
Derivative of negative integer order equals m-fold integral plus polynomial complementary terms
Integer-order derivative agrees with ordinary derivative
Composition (index) law for fractional derivatives, exact when μ positive integer or ν negative integer

items.english: Every value of ∂^{ν+μ}z is thus also a value of ∂^μ∂^ν z; but the converse holds only if μ is a positive integer or ν a negative integer.
